subject: Blue Nova — token runway & budget checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@bluenova.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Blue Nova — token runway & budget checklist

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and the specific asks we agreed on so we can align the invoice estimate: 

- Current expected steady-state usage: ~20M tokens/day (inference only) with spikes to ~35M tokens/day during campaign windows.
- Initial pilot window: 3 months, targeting ~800M tokens total over the pilot.
- Long-term runway: planning for a 12 month ramp to ~600M tokens/month.
- Budget guidance you gave: $TBD but aiming for "$18k–$30k per month" for early phases; you said finance would need a formal $/1M-token target to greenlight.

Requested next steps from our side:
1) We will produce a simple invoice estimate with 3 unit-econ scenarios (conservative / mid / aggressive) showing $/1M-token, expected monthly invoice, and uplift if KV caching or quantization is applied.
2) Marissa will sketch a technical runbook for prefix caching and recommended model variant to align latency vs cost.
3) Rishi will validate discounts for reserved commitment bands.

Attached: 20261105-token-runway.xlsx — lightweight calculator, please update the "actuals" tab with any adjusted daily token numbers if what I captured is off.

Can you confirm the pilot start date remains Nov 16 and whether the pilot needs SOC2 evidence before kickoff?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

[Attachment: 20261105-token-runway.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alex Kim <alex@bluenova.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya@bluenova.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Blue Nova — token runway & budget checklist

Jordan — thanks for the recap and the workbook. Quick confirmations: 

- Pilot start still Nov 16. SOC2 evidence: yes, we need a SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 letter) before production ramp beyond pilot. Pilot OK without it but must have a signed NDA in place — our legal has requested that.
- Token numbers: your captured numbers look right. For clarity, our expected monthly for pilot is ~800M (across two services), ramp to 600M/month in 3–6 months is correct.
- Budget: finance gave a soft guardrail of $25k/month for the first 3 months (they asked if we could get to <$16.7k per 1M tokens for pilot economics — effectively target $/1M = $16.7k given our expected pilot volume). If you can show a mid-case at or below that we'll be in good shape.

Can you convert the workbook to a downloadable CSV too? Our procurement team wants to drop it into their cost tool. Also, include an example invoice line itemization (tokens, storage, support, reserved surge) so procurement has something to ingest.

—Alex
Head of Product | Blue Nova
alex@bluenova.ai

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 15:02 Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original message omitted]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@bluenova.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Blue Nova — token runway & budget checklist

Alex — appreciate the quick clarity. Attached are two items: 1) a CSV export of the token-runway workbook, and 2) a short unit-econ scenarios file that lays out three price bands. At a high level: 

- Conservative: $/1M = $22,000 -> pilot invoice ~ $17.6k/month (no reserved commit, on-demand runtime)
- Mid (recommended): $/1M = $16,500 -> pilot invoice ~ $13.2k/month with a small 3-month reserved commit (10% commit credit + cache enabled)
- Aggressive: $/1M = $12,000 -> pilot invoice ~ $9.6k/month with a 6–12 month reserved band and quantized model option (best cost but requires more engineering validation)

Notes: the per-1M price above reflects token-only inference compute + small model cache charge. We included line items for support (standard enterprise), storage for KV cache snapshots, and a conservative 5% network egress placeholder.

Attached: 20261107-unit-econ-scenarios.csv, 20261105-token-runway.xlsx (CSV tab).

Next steps: 
- Marissa: can you draft the short runbook and recommended model variant (gpt-medium-quantized or gpt-medium-fp16) with expected latency targets and a simple checklist for QA?
- Rishi: can you validate the mid-case discounting and confirm any minimums for the 3-month reserved commit to achieve $16.5k/1M? If not, we'll present a blended invoice that hits Alex's $16.7k target for the pilot only.

I'll prepare a provisional invoice (PDF) and route for internal approval — target to share early next week.

Thanks — Jordan

[Attachments: 20261107-unit-econ-scenarios.csv (CSV), 20261105-token-runway.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Blue Nova — token runway & budget checklist (invoice draft attached)

Forwarding the provisional invoice I assembled after Jordan's note. Highlights: 

- Pilot invoice (monthly mid-case): $13,200/month (reflects $16.5k per 1M with our 10% commit credit applied across the pilot volume).
- Line items: inference tokens ($11,500), KV cache storage ($900), support & monitoring ($1,200), network/egress estimate ($600).
- One-time setup: $2,500 (includes runbook review, deployment assist, and a short performance tuning window).
- Terms: 30-day net; pilot priced as month-to-month with option to convert pilot spend to reserved credits at a 6% conversion bonus if committed within 30 days of pilot end.

See attached: 20261109-invoice-estimate.pdf (PDF stub) and a Drive link with the canonical spreadsheet: https://drive.example.com/file/d/1A2b3C-token-runway/view

Jordan — if this looks good, I'll send the formal quote and a short procurement packet for Blue Nova (includes SOC2 letter template and a sample SOW).

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
